responsibility: Implements GCC’s automatic documentation-link generation for quoted diagnostic text. It defines a urlifier that maps recognized quoted pragmas and options to GCC manual URL suffixes, handles option-prefix remapping such as -fno- variants via the option tables, constructs full documentation URLs, and provides RAII override support for temporarily swapping the urlifier on global_dc.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable logic in the gcc-urlifier group: unlike gcc/gcc-urlifier.h, which declares URLifier classes/helpers, and gcc/gcc-urlifier.def, which is only the data table, this file implements lookup, option remapping, URL construction, RAII override behavior, and selftests.
